title: Use only hosted web search for general research
hypothesis: Removing irrelevant local coding tools from general web-research requests preserves deterministic answer quality while reducing median estimated input cost or latency by at least 10%.
falsified_if: Any treatment hard gate fails, treatment pass rate is below control, the simple-prompt negative control starts searching, or neither median estimated input cost nor median latency improves by at least 10% on general_web_research.
deterministic_outcomes: all existing scenario hard gates remain authoritative
general research retains current authoritative coverage and source links
simple_prompt remains correct with one model call and no hosted search
efficiency_outcomes: prompt, uncached, cached, cache-write, and output tokens
elapsed time, model calls, and tool calls
decision_rule: Accept only if all five web_only runs pass in both scenarios, pass rate is no worse than control, simple_prompt uses one model call without hosted search, and web_only reduces either median estimated_input_cost_usd or median elapsed_ms on general_web_research by at least 10% without increasing the other by more than 10%. Otherwise reject.
